errors.evidence: The description misrepresents the question presented in the chart's title. The chart asks "Смятате ли, че тръжните документи на английски език затрудняват прилагането им?" (Do you think that tender documents in English make their application difficult?). The generated description changes the question to be about whether the difficulties are "due to a lack of translation from English to Bulgarian," which is an interpretation based on the external figure caption, not the text on the chart itself.
